definition: lack of taste; tastelessness.

example: ಕೋಪಗೊಂಡ ಅವನು ಎದುರಾಳಿಯ ಎದೆಗೆ ಬಲವಾಗಿ ತಿವಿದನು.
example_en: Enraged, he punched his opponent hard in the chest.

definition: a highly victorious man.
example_en: That highly victorious man won in all the wars.

definition: a speech planting hopes in the mind of others.

definition: to carry (something) as far as; to reach.

definition: the intention - anything intended or planned; aim, end or purpose.

definition: the soft, curly hairs.

definition: a sword or any other cutting weapon having a series of sharp teeth.

definition: any kind of cake that has a hole at the centre.

definition: a wall enclosing a building, esp. a temple, and its adjoining place.

definition: a male peafowl, having brilliant plumage and a tail (with eyelike markings) that can be expanded erect in display like a fan; a pea-cock.

definition: infinitesimal - a) too small to be measured; infinitely small; b) (math.) of or pertaining to an infinitesimal.

definition: the state or quality of being honest; honesty - a) a refraining from lying, cheating or stealing; a being truthful, trustworthy or upright; b) sincerity; fairness; straightforwardness; c) chastity.

definition: the act of filling or completing with something.

definition: a variety of rice.

definition: the plant Papaver somniferum of Papaveraceae family, with greyish-green leaves and large, white or purple flowers, the source of opium; opium poppy.
example_en: They grow opium poppy plants in this field.

definition: an ornament.

definition: causing or inflicting wounds or pain.

definition: totalling one more than six; seven.

definition: any colour, paint, hue or dye.

definition: a tender coconut.

definition: a tinkling bangle or wristlet.

definition: uncombed, dishevelled or ungroomed hair.

definition: act of process of diffusing; comprehension; universal pervasion.

definition: a disorder of an emotional or physical nature.

definition: a passage for water; a channel.

definition: taking rest; not occupied.

definition: to cause to run.

definition: a variety of sugar cane.

definition: a string of pearls.

definition: prime youth.

definition: the lord of one's life.

definition: (said of animals like ox, camel etc.) to have a hump ( on the back).

definition: work done or articles made by manual skill; handicraft-work.

definition: holding or containing as much as possible; full.

definition: a tooth on the surface of which a thin film containing mucin, bacteria, etc. is formed; a plaque-tooth.

definition: the act or an instance of whispering.

definition: a village or small town.

definition: to have a longing for; to desire.

definition: the state, fact or an instance of being absent; absence.

example_en: The war desolated the kingdom.

definition: the state or quality of being fully grown; maturity.
example: ಆ ಬೆಳೆ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಓಗರ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಗೆ ತಲುಪಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That crop had reached the state of full maturity.

definition: a swaying or swinging backward and forward, from side to side greatly.
example_en: The swaying of the tree branches could be seen in the storm.

definition: a kind of sweet cake.
example_en: They served malpua sweet cakes at the wedding feast.

definition: a long eye.
example: ಕವಿ ಅವಳ ಚೆಲ್ಲೆಗಣ್ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಪದ್ಯ ಬರೆದನು.
example_en: The poet wrote a verse about her long eyes.

definition: the goddess of forest.
example: ಗ್ರಾಮಸ್ಥರು ಕಾಸರದೇವಿಗೆ ಕಾಡಿನ ಬಳಿ ಪೂಜೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The villagers offered worship to the forest goddess near the forest.

definition: the act of falling.
example_en: The falling of the building alarmed everyone.

definition: a mark or tear made in a surface by something sharp or rough; a scratch.
example_en: A scratch from the knife is visible on the table.

definition: a female dancer.
example_en: The female dancer performed a dance on the stage.

definition: the virtue of self-knowledge.
example_en: Through meditation he attained self-knowledge.

definition: to be in a prison.
example_en: The criminal was in prison for many years.

definition: the state, quality or fact of being nude; nakedness; nudity.
example_en: Nudity is depicted artistically in that sculpture.

definition: to increase oneself in volume, quantity or degree.
example_en: During the rainy season, the river's water increases in volume.

definition: a deaf ear.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಹೇಳಿದರೂ ಕಿವುಡುಗಿವಿ, ಏನೂ ಕೇಳಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: However much you tell him, he has a deaf ear and hears nothing.

definition: the condition of being weary, tired, exhausted.
example_en: The long journey left him utterly exhausted.

definition: the civil supplies department of the government.
example_en: That file was sent to the civil supplies department.

definition: the next life following the death in the present life.
example_en: Good deeds bring happiness in the next life.

definition: possessing vigour or might, strong; powerful.
example: ಹೊಸ ಔಷಧಿ ರೋಗ ಗುಣಪಡಿಸಲು ಬಹಳ ಫಲಕಾರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: The new medicine is very effective in curing the disease.

definition: a tumour composed of bony tissue; an osteal tumour; osteoma.
example_en: The doctor examined the bony tumour on his leg.

definition: want of observation.
example_en: A big mistake occurred due to his want of observation.

definition: in an extraordinary manner; extraordinarily.
example_en: He astonished everyone in an extraordinary manner.

definition: the outermost door.
example_en: The outermost door of the fort was tightly shut.

definition: any of several large social wasps of the Vespidae family, of striking yellow and black colour, having a vicious sting that can be used repeatedly; a hornet wasp.
example_en: The sting of the hornet wasp causes a lot of pain.

definition: a camphor crystal.
example_en: The camphor crystal in that box looked pure.

definition: a woman (in gen.).
example: ಒಬ್ಬ ಲಳನೆ ಬಾವಿಯ ಬಳಿ ನೀರು ಸೇದುತ್ತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: A woman was drawing water near the well.

definition: the plant Dioscorea oppositifolia of Dioscoraceae family.
example_en: The root of the Dioscorea oppositifolia plant is used as medicine.

definition: any of a set of hard, bonelike structures set in the jaws of most vertebrates and used for biting, tearing, and chewing: a tooth.
example: ಪಲ್ ನೋವಿನಿಂದ ಆತ ರಾತ್ರಿ ನಿದ್ರೆ ಮಾಡಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: He could not sleep at night due to tooth pain.

definition: a realisation that happens in the mind in understanding a fact.
example_en: The teacher's words gave him a realisation of the truth.

definition: an abominable, heinous sin.
example_en: The scriptures say that killing one's teacher is a heinous sin.

definition: to come, arrive late.
example_en: He missed the train and arrived late to the office.

definition: to blame; to accuse.
example_en: He accused the innocent person.

definition: the mind which has attained more maturity to its age; precocious mind.
example_en: The boy's precocious mind astonished everyone.

definition: the act of seeing; beholding; a looking at.
example_en: The beholding of nature gives peace to the mind.

definition: the respiratory tract or oesophagus; the wind-pipe or food-tube.
example_en: Food got stuck in his windpipe and he choked.

definition: the deciduous tree Careya arborea of Myrtaceae family, usu. of medium size with obovate leaves.
example_en: A gavvele tree stood at the edge of the forest.

definition: a military attack.
example_en: The army carried out a military attack on the enemy.

definition: a man belonging to Tamil Nadu, in south India or a Tamil-speaking man chiefly in Tamil Nadu or Sri Lanka.
example_en: That Tamil man had come from Chennai.

definition: a long, round tool for pounding or grinding substances in a mortar; a pestle.
example_en: She pounded the pepper with a pestle.

definition: the quality that delights the eyes; beauty; charm.
example_en: That painting had rare beauty.

definition: the quality of condition of being full or filled completely with; fullness.
example_en: The fullness of the basket brought her joy.

definition: a rock that is slippery.
example: ಆ ಜಾಱುಕಲ್ಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ನಡೆಯುವಾಗ ಜಾಗ್ರತೆ ಇರಲಿ.
example_en: Be careful while walking on that slippery rock.

definition: (the order, successiveness) to get disturbed or spoiled.
example_en: The order of the programme suddenly got disturbed.

definition: the plant Manihot esculenta ( = M. utilissima) of Euphorbiaceae family; cassava plant.
example_en: The farmers grew cassava and sold it.

definition: the quality of not being attentive or observant; inadvrtence.
example_en: Mistakes happened in the exam because of his inattentiveness.

definition: an ache or pain in the ear; otalgia; ear-ache.
example_en: My earache is troubling me a lot.

definition: the quality of being hot; hotness; heat.
example_en: It was hard to bear the heat of summer.

definition: to give support or encouragement to; to second (another's opinion, proposal, etc.).
example_en: All the friends seconded and supported his proposal.

definition: a period of suspension of work, study or other activity, usu. used for rest, recreation or travel; recess or holiday; vacation.
example_en: During the summer vacation, the children went to their hometown.

definition: the act of slipping, going quietly or secretly; an evasion or escape.
example_en: He quietly slipped away from the meeting.

definition: falling in or as in drops; dripping.
example: ಮಳೆಗಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೂರಿನಿಂದ ದ್ರಪ್ಸ ನೀರು ಕೆಳಗೆ ಬೀಳುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: During the rainy season, dripping water was falling from the roof.

definition: crude camphor, a brilliantly white drug.
example_en: They burned crude camphor in the temple.

definition: a going, moving forward or ahead; an instance of this.
example_en: The country's forward progress is a matter of pride for everyone.

definition: to turn suddenly to one side.
example: ಅವನು ಒಡಮುರಿದು ನೋಡಿದಾಗ ಎದುರಿಗೆ ಹುಲಿ ಕಂಡಿತು.
example_en: When he turned suddenly to one side and looked, he saw a tiger in front of him.

definition: to go behind; to follow.
example_en: The dog followed behind its master and came home.

definition: the plant Glycine javanica of Papilionaceae family, a fast growing hairy perennial vine.
example: ರೈತರು ಹೊಲದ ಬೇಲಿಗೆ ಉಪ್ಪವರೆ ಬಳ್ಳಿ ಬೆಳೆಸಿದರು.
example_en: The farmers grew the uppavare vine on the field fence.

definition: to cut and turn up soil with a farm implement kuṇṭe to remove the weeds.
example: ರೈತ ಬೆಳೆಯ ಕಳೆ ತೆಗೆಯಲು ಹೊಲವನ್ನು ಹರಗಿದನು.
example_en: The farmer harrowed the field to remove the weeds from the crop.

definition: transparent, colourless or slightly tinged quartz; a crystal.
example_en: She likes bangles made of crystal.

definition: a counselling with persons in close circles; a private and intimate counselling.
example_en: The king held a private counselling with the ministers.

definition: to identify, recognise or recollect (with the help of a sign, mark, symbol, token etc.).
example_en: He recognised his old friend by the mark.

definition: a false statement; a lie.
example_en: Everyone came to know his false statement.

definition: want of digestion.
example_en: The doctor gave medicine for his indigestion.

definition: a liveable apartment under the ground; a storey of a building, below the ground level.
example_en: That house had an underground apartment.

definition: to solve a (difficult) problem; to untangle.
example_en: He cleverly untangled that complicated problem.

definition: tall; towering.
example_en: The mountain peak was towering as if touching the sky.

definition: of or related to an individual, one's house or family; not public; not related to the state; private.
example_en: That is his private matter.

definition: a ball used in a game in which it is thrown from one to another to reach it to a particular point.
example_en: The boys threw the poḍeśanḍu ball at the target.

definition: he who plays a vīṇe.
example: ಆ ವೀಣೆಗಾಱ ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಂದರ ಕಚೇರಿ ನಡೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: That vīṇe player gave a beautiful concert in the assembly.

definition: in a place or on a level below another.
example_en: The book is in the cupboard shelf below the table.

definition: to waste time in trifling or being slow; to dawdle.
example: ಕೆಲಸ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಅವನು ಬರೀ ನ್ಯಾವಣಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಕುಳಿತ.
example_en: Leaving the work, he sat merely dawdling.

definition: a petroleum gas used as fuel in cooking; cooking gas.
example_en: The price of a cooking gas cylinder has increased.

definition: a forest-wanderer.
example_en: The forest-wanderer roamed alone in the forest.

definition: to understand the unexpressed feelings of another person.
example_en: A good friend can understand another's unexpressed feelings.

definition: an interjection used to point out an object which is relatively near.
example_en: Here, your umbrella is right here.

definition: a man whose essential character is engaging in a quarrel or inciting other for it.
example: ಆ ಕಲಹಾಶನ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಜಗಳ ಹಚ್ಚುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That quarrelsome man always stirs up fights in the village.

definition: the sound of the heart-beat.
example_en: In fear, the sound of his heart-beat could be heard loudly.

definition: the son or daughter of one's paternal uncle.
example_en: He is my cousin, my paternal uncle's son.

definition: a place, an area.
example_en: This is a peaceful place.

definition: a partition wall in a building.
example: ಮದಿಲ ಕಟ್ಟಿ ಮನೆಯನ್ನು ಎರಡು ಭಾಗ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: They built a partition wall and divided the house into two parts.

definition: quickly; swiftly; rapidly.
example_en: The soldiers went quickly toward the border.

definition: causing a person become unconscious.
example_en: That fragrance had an enchanting, mind-numbing effect.

definition: a man who sells gold and silver articles, jewelry, etc.
example: ಆ ಶರಾಫ ಪೇಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳ್ಳಿಯ ಆಭರಣ ಮಾರುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That jeweler sells silver ornaments in the market.

definition: the flower of the plant Hibiscus rosa-sinensis.
example_en: The child plucked a hibiscus flower and brought it.

definition: that which is flat (and usu. relatively thin).
example_en: She rolled the chapati thin and flat.

definition: difficult or impossible to get.
example_en: That medicine is now difficult to get.

definition: to move unsteadily.
example_en: The drunk man walked unsteadily on the road.

definition: a lot of work (that has come on to a person at a time).
example: ಇಂದು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಹೊರೆಗೆಲಸ ಬಂದಿದೆ, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸಮಯ ಕೊಡು.
example_en: A lot of work has come upon him today, so give him some time.

definition: one without shelter or protection; a homeless man.
example_en: That homeless man used to sleep on the street.

definition: amounting to two times in capacity, quantity, size, extent or number.
example_en: This year the crop doubled.

definition: the chief of an army.
example_en: The army chief stood in front of the army and spoke.

definition: a flash of lightning that is not straight.
example_en: A crooked flash of lightning flashed in the sky.

definition: offering oneself (as a living sacrifice) to a deity; self-immolation.
example: ಆ ಭಕ್ತ ದೇವರ ಮುಂದೆ ಆತ್ಮಾರ್ಪಣೆ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: That devotee offered himself as a sacrifice before the god.

definition: a man who habitually lies; a lier.
example_en: People do not give value to a habitual liar.

definition: a drama having fictitious romantic plot, whose hero is a sedate, broadminded, generous man.
example: ಆ ಪಗರಣೆಯ ನಾಯಕ ಬಹಳ ಔದಾರ್ಯದ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ.
example_en: The hero of that romantic drama is a very generous person.

definition: a smith who works in iron; a blacksmith.
example_en: The blacksmith heated the iron in the furnace.

definition: the act of hiding, concealing something.
example: ಆ ಸುದ್ದಿಯ ಗೂಹನ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಅನುಮಾನ ಮೂಡಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The concealing of that news raised suspicion in everyone.

definition: (braided or tied hair) to become dishevelled.
example_en: Her braided hair became dishevelled in the wind.

definition: the 12th day in the eighth month of a lunar year.
example_en: On Utthana Dwadashi, people worship the tulasi plant.

definition: the regular work period of work by a group of people, working in relay with another or other groups; a shift.
example: ಕಾರ್ಖಾನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರು ಸೂಳುಪಾಳು ಪದ್ಧತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The workers in the factory work on a shift system.

definition: any voluntary act of the mind or gesture in expressing one's suppressed feelings.
example: ಅವನ ಸಂತೋಷದ ವಿಜೃಂಭಿತ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮನ ಮುಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: His outward expression of joy touched everyone's heart.

definition: loss of semen.
example_en: His health deteriorated due to excessive loss of semen.

definition: a foot wearing a shoe, sandal, etc.
example_en: With shoe-clad feet, he walked along the thorny path.

definition: a group of people considered as a unit according to economic, occupational or social status; esp., a social rank or caste; a class.
example: ಅವರು ತಮ್ಮ ವಿಲೆಯ ಜನರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬೆರೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: They mingled only with people of their own class.

definition: the study of evidences, proofs, etc., in deciding a legal suit.
example_en: He studied the science of legal evidence at the university.

definition: the tree Samania saman ( = Pithecolobium saman) of Mimoseae family, having spreading branches and dense heads of small, pink flowers; rain tree.
example: ರಸ್ತೆಯ ಬದಿಯ ಮಳೆಮರದ ಕೆಳಗೆ ನಾವು ನೆರಳಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಶ್ರಮಿಸಿದೆವು.
example_en: We rested in the shade under the rain tree beside the road.

definition: the legal decision order, judgment of a tribunal.
example_en: The court's judgment surprised everyone.

definition: to overflow; to inundate; to deluge.
example_en: The river water overflowed its bank.

definition: a battle or combat.
example: ಆ ಪೋರಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ರಾಜನ ಸೈನ್ಯ ಸೋಲನ್ನು ಕಂಡಿತು.
example_en: The king's army faced defeat in that battle.

definition: to be torn asunder; to be split violently.
example_en: Caught in the storm, the ship was torn asunder.

definition: (a gong or the like) to make a heavy, metallic, resonant sound (when stuck repeatedly).
example_en: The gong was making a heavy metallic sound in the temple.

definition: the four faces or surfaces of a thing.
example_en: All four faces of that stone were carved smoothly.

definition: (mus.) the expanse from the base note to the same note in the next higher or lower octave.
example: ಗಾಯಕ ಆ ರಾಗದ ಠಾಯವನ್ನು ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿ ಹಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The singer beautifully rendered the octave-span of that raga.

definition: (n.) a war-drum.
example_en: They beat the war-drum before the battle.

definition: a decayed, carious tooth.
example: ಹುಳುಕುಹಲ್ಲಿನ ನೋವಿನಿಂದ ಅವನು ವೈದ್ಯರ ಬಳಿ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: He went to the doctor because of the pain from the decayed tooth.

definition: the quality or condition of being cold; coldness.
example_en: There is a cold climate on the hill.

definition: the act or manner of expressing; expression.
example_en: The expression of emotions in the poet's poem is beautiful.

definition: an allowance paid for supervising a public work.
example_en: A supervision allowance was given to the contractor.

definition: to cause to wake from or as from sleep.
example_en: The mother woke up the child in the morning.

definition: an onomatopoeic word formed to denote flicking lamp or light emited intermittently).
example_en: The flickering of the lamp was seen in the darkness.

definition: a thirsty woman.
example_en: The thirsty woman who had walked in the sun searched for water.

definition: a honey-bee, that collects nectar from flowers.
example_en: The honey-bee collected nectar from the flowers of the garden.

definition: a particular school of thought among Jainism.
example: ಜೈನ ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯದಲ್ಲಿ ತೇರಹಪಂಥ ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಪಂಥವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: In the Jain tradition, the Terahapantha is an important school of thought.

definition: a ball of stone, glass or clay used to play with; a marble.
example_en: The children were playing with marbles.

definition: the bottom of a ship.
example_en: The waves crashed against the bottom of the ship.

definition: having the quality of describing; characterised by description; descriptive.
example_en: His writing was very descriptive.

definition: an expedient, means that occurs at the moment.
example_en: An immediate expedient occurred to him at the time of crisis.

definition: a very pungent, heart-pricking remark.
example: ಅವನ ಕಕ್ಕಸಮೂದಲೆ ಕೇಳಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ತಲೆ ತಗ್ಗಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Hearing his heart-pricking remark, everyone bowed their heads.

definition: uncultivated land; fallow land.
example: ಆ ಹಡು ಹಲವು ವರ್ಷಗಳಿಂದ ಬೇಸಾಯವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಬಿದ್ದಿದೆ.
example_en: That fallow land has lain uncultivated for many years.

definition: love; affection.
example_en: Her love was an ideal for everyone.

definition: waste matter expelled from the bowels; faeces; excrement.
example_en: The faeces should be disposed of properly.

definition: to deliver a blow, stroke; to strike.
example_en: He struck the enemy with a sword.

definition: people who live in villages, towns (as dif. from those who live in cities).
example_en: The village people came to the market and sold vegetables.

definition: a fair held at regular intervals for sale of fish, meat, etc.
example: ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಜನ ಮೈಲಿಗೆಸಂತೆಗೆ ಮೀನು ಖರೀದಿಸಲು ಹೋದರು.
example_en: The village people went to the fish-and-meat fair to buy fish.

definition: the quality or tendency to be straight, righteous; righteousness.
example_en: His righteousness was an example to everyone.

definition: the act of praising, extolling or flattering.
example_en: The poet's writing received the king's praise.

definition: being or placed at a considerable height.
example_en: There is a temple at the very high peak of the mountain.

definition: to slip down away from the hand, fingers, etc.; to escape from a hold, seizure.
example_en: The slippery rope slipped away from the hand.

definition: the ruddy goose, the male and female of which are supposed to be together always.
example_en: A pair of ruddy geese appeared near the river.

definition: to spread (one's) plumage (as a peacock while dancing).
example_en: In the forest, the peacock spread its plumage and danced.

definition: to violate an order; to disobey a command.
example: ಸೈನಿಕನು ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಯ ಆಜ್ಞೆಯನ್ನು ಬೆಸದಪ್ಪಿ ಶಿಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ಒಳಗಾದನು.
example_en: The soldier disobeyed the officer's command and was punished.

definition: to come; to approach.
example_en: The guests approached near the house.

definition: the care and raising of domesticated cattle; animal husbandry.
example_en: The farmer is engaged in cattle rearing.

definition: hot sunlinght.
example_en: The hot afternoon sunlight dried the clothes quickly.

definition: a vigilent supervision by oneself.
example: ಅವಳು ತನ್ನ ಕೆಲಸದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಣ್ಗಾಪು ಇಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: She kept a vigilant watch over her own work.

definition: the reed Saccharum sara ( = S. munja) of Poaceae family.
example_en: The reed grew on the bank of the pond.

definition: a young ox.
example_en: The farmer yoked the young ox to the plough.

definition: a sudden, sharp pain caused by involuntary contraction of a muscle or muscles from chill, strain, etc.; cramp.
example_en: He got a cramp in his hand from the cold.

definition: the abode of gods; heaven; paradise.
example_en: In the puranas, heaven is said to be the abode of the gods.

definition: transgression of divine law; any act regarded as a transgression, esp. a wilful or deliberate violation of some religious or moral principle; a sin.
example: ಸುಳ್ಳಾಡುವುದು ಕೂಡ ಒಂದು ದುರಿತವೆಂದು ಗುರುಗಳು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The teacher said that even lying is a sin.

definition: a man who gives great joy or plesures to others.
example_en: He was a man who brought great joy to everyone.

definition: to be satisfied; to get contentment.
example_en: He was satisfied after the meal.

definition: to get or have comfort.
example_en: She got comfort from the cool breeze.

definition: to continue to live; to be alive; to carry on one's life.
example_en: He lived for a hundred years.

definition: skill; proficiency; expertise.
example: ಅವನ ಬದ್ದು ಈ ಕೆಲಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: His proficiency stands out in this work.

definition: a system of astrology which, by using modern optical instruments as telescope, etc., foretells the future.
example_en: Modern astrologers use the dřksiddhānta system based on optical instruments.

definition: to be successfully executed or effected; tobe completed, accomplished.
example_en: The construction work was finally completed.

definition: to catch a person (alive); to arrest; to take another into one's custody.
example_en: The police caught the thief and took him to the station.

definition: (bad smell) to be emited; (rancid smell) to spread.
example_en: A pungent smell spread from the rotten meat.

definition: free from being or not suffering from the defects of, dualistic nature ; non-dual; one and alone.
example: ಸಾಧಕರು ಅದ್ವಂದ್ವ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು ತಲುಪಲು ಧ್ಯಾನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Seekers meditate to attain the non-dual state.

definition: a man who proclaims in public.
example: ಆ ಪ್ರಚಾರಕ ಊರಲ್ಲಿ ಧರ್ಮದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮಾತನಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That man who proclaims in public spoke about religion in the village.

definition: the act or power of controlling.
example: ರಾಜನ ಹಿಡಿತಡೆ ಇಡೀ ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಲವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The king's control was strong over the whole kingdom.

definition: one who talks senselessly and continuously.
example: ಆ ಬಾಯ್ಗೇಡಿಯ ಮಾತು ಯಾರೂ ಕಿವಿಗೆ ಹಾಕಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: No one pays heed to that senseless talker's words.

definition: a sort of pain as caused by a piercing stroke of a staff or cudgel.
example_en: A piercing pain appeared on the back from the blow of the staff.

definition: an objection; a restriction.
example_en: The committee raised an objection to that plan.

definition: a maid servant.
example_en: A maid servant was cooking in that house.

definition: to get the price for a commodity sold.
example: ರೈತ ತನ್ನ ಬೆಳೆಗೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ವೆಲೆಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಸಂತೆಗೆ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: The farmer went to the market to get a good price for his crop.

definition: to wear but a single long cloth covering one's privy parts.
example: ಸನ್ಯಾಸಿ ಒಂದೇ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ಕೌಪುದಳೆದು ಅಡವಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇದ್ದನು.
example_en: The ascetic, wearing just a single loin cloth, lived in the forest.

definition: the act or process of drawing away.
example_en: The withdrawal of the army caught the enemies' attention.

definition: an apparatus for forcing water into a boiler; an injector.
example_en: They used an injector to force water into the boiler.

definition: to take bribes.
example_en: The people were outraged to see the officer taking bribes.

definition: that whose surface is rough.
example_en: The bark of that tree had a rough surface.

definition: that which is fit to be seen or is pleasant to the sight.
example_en: That flower is pleasant to the sight.

definition: to cause to push out; to cause to spit.
example_en: He made him spit out the saliva from his mouth.

definition: with a creak or squeaking sound.
example_en: The door opened with a creak.

definition: a shower of stones; a continuous hurling of stones.
example_en: A continuous shower of stones took place during the riot.

definition: a man in relation with whom he has a deep hatred; an enemy; an opponent.
example_en: Those two were sworn enemies of each other.

definition: an outer, upper garment, with or without sleeves, of women.
example_en: The village women were stitching blouses by hand.

definition: a colourless, odourless, incombustible gas, CO2 , somewhat heavier than air, (a product of respiration or combustion), produced commercially and used widely in fire extinguishers, carbonated beverages, etc.; carbon dioxide.
example: ಸಸ್ಯಗಳು ಅಂಗಾರಾಮ್ಲವನ್ನು ಹೀರಿ ಆಮ್ಲಜನಕವನ್ನು ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.
example_en: Plants absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen.

definition: the plant Adhatoda vasica ( = Justicia adhatoda) of Acanthaceae family.
example_en: The Adhatoda vasica plant is used for medicine.

definition: a hard try; an attempt; an endeavour; effort.
example_en: The farmer made an effort to grow the crop.

definition: the condition of the foot being cracked usu. at the heel.
example_en: In winter, cracked heels appeared on his feet.

definition: a female cuckoo.
example: ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಕಳಕಂಠಿ ಕುಹೂ ಕುಹೂ ಎಂದು ಕೂಗಿತು.
example_en: In the morning the female cuckoo cooed 'kuhoo kuhoo'.
